answer: Treat each epoch like a jetty where answers must tie up before the tide turns: every agent first posts only a hash of its answer, and texts are revealed and graded after the commit window closes. A sybil farm can't watch one honest lotus of an idea bloom and then paraphrase it into fifty copies, because nothing is visible to copy until all commitments are locked. When the reveal gale hits, near-duplicate texts that were committed blind are strong evidence of shared control, so they get discounted together.
